management.scheduler: Lock run scope, prevent conflicts, limit job parallelism, no automatic remote retries
management.qa: Verify all project receipts and block missing or tampered evidence
management.manager: Consolidate auditable reports, separate project blockers without hiding failures
management.security: Least-privilege read token for private repo and distinct Actions:write token for explicit dispatch
management.resource_operations: Observe ephemeral GitHub runners; no VPS process kills or RAM cleanup
management.release_manager: Target repository owners alone publish changes; management has no contents write

note: Responsibility boundaries, not independent active LLM agents.
